meta.notes: A classic race, longer: the standard run through the mangroves to Conch Row. Run W-T: the patrol (1 or 2 cops up the road) and the heat meter, as every v1 event has them (docs/content-packs.md, "Event"; the career events had left them out, so a career race met only the lot's cop). Run W-U: the bonus is the Mangrove Boardwalk (the ride-branch objective, was the boat-ramp cut), the back road through the swamp this race is named for. Playtest 3 (T10.1): the purse, the style rewards and the rival pace follow the tier ladder (docs/product-spec.md, Cash and Rivals): the field climbs by tier, the money is smaller and tighter.
